guard: mutation coverage accepts only direct execution witnesses that reach the mutated file without a package resolver
why: The seat packaging suite executes the root native assembler directly, while the launcher smoke executes its own mutated source. Both are stronger witnesses than a by-name package import, and neither should be rejected as a dist trap.
A quoted path in prose is not execution. The self-test keeps that negative control beside both accepted direct paths.

mutations.name: a suite mutating its own directly executed source is rejected
mutations.expectRed: a suite is gradable when it directly executes the file being mutated

mutations.name: a suite launching the exact mutated repo script is rejected
mutations.expectRed: a suite is gradable when it launches the exact mutated script path

mutations.name: any quoted mutation path is treated as a direct execution witness
mutations.expectRed: a quoted script path without an invocation is refused
